_comment: Labeled sentences for concept tagging. Each case gives a sentence, the
concept under test, and the expected outcome:
affirmed    - mention found, counts as positive risk signal
historical  - mention found, historical flag set, still positive
negated     - mention found but negated: must NOT count
hypothetical- mention found but conditional/instructional: must NOT count
family      - mention found but about a relative: must NOT count
none        - no mention of this concept may be found at all
This file is the quality bar. The tagger implementation (medspaCy rules
today, possibly a model later) is swappable; these labels are not.
Sentences are modeled on real MIMIC phrasing seen during the A1 probe.
